# Lundinfamiljen miljardsäljer – Har verkstad peakat?

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon (18 Sep 2026) with Nordnet's savings economist Carl-Henrik Söderberg and Pinpoint's Oscar Mattsson. Global rate hikes (Fed, Bank of Japan, ECB), oil above $100 and hot German producer prices are weighing on markets, but strong earnings growth keeps the bull market alive. The main question is whether Swedish industrials have peaked: PMI looks close to its highs, and the sector has lagged the index since summer despite strong Q2 reports. The Q3 reporting season is seen as critical. Consensus expects strong revenue growth, and full-year estimates for the smallest companies were revised up last quarter. Stock-specific news covered Volvo Cars' strategy day, IPC's buybacks, and analyst moves on Gränges, Husqvarna, Medicover and AstraZeneca.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 GRNG — Gränges | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Nordea Markets upgraded to buy; shares up 3-4.5%.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view (Nordea Markets), not the hosts' own. Upgrade to buy moved the shares 3-4.5% on a flat market. Fits the theme of strong industrials, but the hosts also warn that the sector may be tiring before Q3.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 report misses expectations
- if industrial cycle/PMI rolls over

> *"Gränges har fått en höjd rekommendation till köp från Nordea Markets så den är upp 4,5"*

---

### ⛔ HUSQ-B — Husqvarna | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Pareto warns of first-ever Q3 loss on poor summer weather and tougher competition; stock down about 2%.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view (Pareto): poor summer weather plus tougher competition point to Husqvarna's first-ever Q3 loss. That is negative going into the reporting season, when misses have been punished harder than beats are rewarded.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 result beats the pessimistic Pareto view
- if competitive pressure eases

> *"varnar analyshuset Pareto nu för att trädgårdsutrustaren kommer att rapportera sin första förlust för ett tredje kvartal"*

---

### 🟢 MCOV-B — Medicover | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

SEB raised target price and reiterated buy; shares up about 4%.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view (SEB): higher target price and a reiterated buy. Pinpoint also noted that healthcare companies are driving a large share of expected revenue growth.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 growth disappoints
- if SEB cuts its recommendation

> *"Medicover stiger närmare 4 procent. Där har SEB höjt riktkursen och upprepat sin köprekommendation."*

---

### 🟢 IPCO — International Petroleum Corp | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

CEO sees stock as undervalued: $2.5bn cumulative FCF to 2030 at $95 oil vs ~$3bn market cap; ongoing buybacks.

#### Reasoning

This is management's view, not the hosts'. At $95 oil, IPC's five-year free cash flow would be close to its market cap. Management keeps buying back shares and says average buyback prices are well below today's price. Blackrod phase 1 and later phases add production growth. The hosts note that Lundin CEOs always call their stock undervalued, so conviction is tempered.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil prices fall sharply from ~$95
- if Blackrod expansion is delayed
- if buybacks stop

> *"vilket underbygger vår tro på att vi är undervärderade som företag och varför vi fortsätter att köpa tillbaka aktier"*

---

### 🟠 VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Strategy looks sensible and P/E is 5, but the market wants proof; competition is stiff and Chinese consumers are cautious.

#### Reasoning

Guest Söderberg thinks the strategic direction (regionalisation, 13 models, Geely synergies, lean overhead) feels right and the valuation is low at P/E 5. The market reaction was flat, and he says investors want to see execution in a tough market with Chinese hypercompetition.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Chinese competition erodes margins further
- if the new strategy fails to lift results
- if EU tariff protection doesn't come

> *"Tittar du på värderingen så är det p e 5. Det känns som att marknadens initiala reaktion är... Vi vill nog se lite för att vi ska tro på det här"*

---

### 🟠 RUG — Rugvista | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Largest owner Jofam keeps adding and holds over 14%; shares up 0.7-1.6%.

#### Reasoning

Steady buying by the controlling owner since spring is a positive insider-style signal. The hosts did not give their own view on fundamentals.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Jofam stops buying or sells

> *"Jofa som är största ägaren har fortsatt öka sen i våras och äger nu över 14 procent av bolaget"*
